title: Decision: draft-mahy-mimi-hub-retracted-messages-00 is track-only for mimid (adopt later with hub moderation)
description:
Assay mimid-1wgh.44.12 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mimi-hub-retracted-messages-00.txt (392 lines, read whole; sha256 in specs/PROVENANCE).

What it is: two AE components carried in AppEphemeral proposals (mls-extensions-11 app_ephemeral, External: Y) from the hub: hub_retracted_messages (suggested 0x0050: retract listed MIMI message IDs, with timestamp, remover URI, optional AbuseType; §3.1 L180-200) and hub_retracted_range (0x0051: retract everything one sender sent, optionally since a timestamp; §3.2 L210-250). Members check the proposer holds canDeleteOtherMessage (or canDeleteOtherReaction for reactions only). Follows a reportAbuse (protocol-07 §5.9). Informational (L7). 0x0050/0x0051 are free (Rohan's coordination gist cites -00).

How it meets mimid: the hub accepts reportAbuse and takes no action; it already recognizes app_ephemeral as a proposal type (crates/mimid-server/src/hub/update.rs:120-122, 841) and has a hub external-sender key (local /v1/hub-sender). Capability values match mimi-room-policy (CAN_DELETE_OTHER_MESSAGE 0x010b, CAN_DELETE_OTHER_REACTION 0x0108; capability.rs:72-79).

RECOMMEND: track only now; adopt later if mimid builds hub moderation (acting on abuse reports). Then: (1) hub: an admin command that sends an AppEphemeral external proposal with either component (the hub computes message IDs from reported plaintext); (2) mimi-mls members: verify the proposer's authority (see wg item 1, unresolved) and apply; (3) JMAP projection: mark retracted messages (deletedAt or a retracted flag). Blocked on the authority question in the wg bead.
close_reason: Mark 2026-11-16: track; adopt if mimid builds hub moderation. Gaps in mimid-1wgh.44.35.
